# Lorraine Gaudio

**PhD student in Computing at Boise State University · RISE Fellow**

I study how people use AI in research and learning communities. I am interested in how new practices spread, how people learn when to trust or question AI, and how these choices shape collaboration and knowledge creation.

My work draws on social network analysis and mixed methods. I am also developing agent-based modeling approaches to study how individual choices can produce larger patterns of social behavior.

## What I am working toward

Emerging AI tools are changing how people learn, conduct research, solve problems, and work with one another. I want to understand those changes at more than one level. What happens when an individual decides to use an AI tool in a particular way? How do those choices spread through groups? When do they strengthen learning, agency, and collaboration, and when might they undermine them?

My current work connects these questions across research, teaching, and responsible technology use.
